head.t: GBUK appointed to NHS Supply Chain's new IV Cannula framework as Becton Dickinson drops out
head.x: NHS Supply Chain has confirmed that Becton Dickinson did not submit a tender for its renewed Intravenous Cannula and Associated Products Framework, which goes live on 1 April 2027, and so has not been appointed despite BD products being widely used across the NHS today.

head.t: Framework ending 12 October 2027: Blood Collection Devices
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "GBUK Ltd". 19 suppliers on the framework.

head.t: Framework ending 30 September 2027: Endoscopy, Endourology and Oncology Ablation Consumables and Associated Products
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "GBUK Ltd" (Lot 2). 58 suppliers on the framework.

head.t: Framework ending 31 August 2027: Advanced Wound Care
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "GBUK Ltd" (Lot 1, Lot 2). 56 suppliers on the framework.
